sprints.name: Sprint 1 — Foundation & pipeline
sprints.goal: A deployed walking skeleton: every merge to main is tested and shipped to AWS automatically; users can register, log in and browse events.

sprints.name: Sprint 2 — Core ticketing
sprints.goal: Fair, real-time ticket buying: waiting room, live seat map, seat holds without double booking, and checkout.

epics.description: Automated quality gates and continuous delivery to AWS (Lightsail + RDS).

issues.summary: Scaffold Next.js app with TypeScript, ESLint and Prettier
issues.description: Initial project structure: Next.js 16 App Router, custom server, BullMQ worker, Prisma.
acceptance: npm run lint, format:check and typecheck pass
Project builds with npm run build
docs/ and tooling folders are git-ignored

issues.summary: Local development environment with Docker Compose (Postgres + Redis)
acceptance: docker compose up starts Postgres and Redis with health checks
A separate test database is created automatically
README documents local setup

issues.summary: CI pipeline: lint, typecheck, unit/integration tests with 80% coverage gate, E2E
acceptance: Runs on every push and pull request to main
Postgres and Redis run as service containers (no shared database)
Build fails if any coverage metric drops below 80%
Playwright E2E runs against the production build

issues.summary: Publish QA reports (coverage, Playwright) to GitHub Pages
acceptance: Reports published on every push to main
Index page links to each report

issues.summary: Provision AWS RDS PostgreSQL and Lightsail instance
acceptance: RDS instance is not publicly accessible
Lightsail reaches RDS via VPC peering; security group allows only the Lightsail CIDR
Lightsail has a static IP, Docker installed and a non-root deploy user
Connection uses SSL (sslmode=require)

issues.summary: CD pipeline: deploy to Lightsail with migrations, smoke test and auto-rollback
acceptance: Triggered only after CI succeeds on main (workflow_run)
Deploys the exact image CI built, tagged with the commit SHA
Runs prisma migrate deploy before restarting
Smoke test confirms /api/health reports the new version
Failed smoke test rolls back to the last good image
Manual rollback via workflow_dispatch

issues.summary: Branch protection and Jira automation rules
acceptance: main requires a pull request and passing CI checks
PR created moves the issue to In Review
Deployment succeeded moves the issue to Done

issues.summary: Security scanning with CodeQL and Dependabot
acceptance: CodeQL runs on pull requests and weekly
Dependabot opens update PRs for npm, Actions and Docker

issues.summary: Uptime monitoring and failure notifications
acceptance: External monitor pings /api/health every 5 minutes
Failed workflows notify by email

issues.summary: Register an account
issues.description: As a fan, I want to create an account so that I can buy and keep my tickets.
acceptance: Email must be valid and unique
Password must be 8-72 characters and is stored hashed
Validation errors are shown next to each field

issues.summary: Log in and log out
issues.description: As a registered fan, I want to log in so that my orders and holds are tied to me.
acceptance: Session cookie is httpOnly, secure and sameSite
Wrong credentials show a generic error
Logging out invalidates the session

issues.summary: Organiser-only pages protected by role (Next.js proxy)
issues.description: As an organiser, I want organiser pages restricted to my role so that fans cannot edit events.
acceptance: Unauthenticated users are redirected to login
Fans receive 403 on organiser routes and actions
Authorisation is re-checked in server actions, not only in the proxy

issues.summary: Browse upcoming events
issues.description: As a fan, I want to see events that are on sale so that I can pick one to attend.
acceptance: Only ON_SALE events in the future are listed, soonest first
Each item shows title, date/time (SGT) and venue

issues.summary: View event details
issues.description: As a fan, I want an event page so that I can see details and price tiers before buying.
acceptance: Route /events/[slug] shows description, venue, date and price tiers
Unknown slug returns the 404 page

issues.summary: Search and filter events
issues.description: As a fan, I want to filter events by keyword, city and date so that I find relevant shows quickly.
acceptance: Filters are reflected in the URL (shareable)
Empty results show a helpful message

issues.summary: Organiser creates and publishes an event
issues.description: As an organiser, I want to create events with seating and prices so that fans can buy tickets.
acceptance: Form uses Server Actions with server-side validation
Event starts as DRAFT and can be published to ON_SALE
Event list cache is revalidated on publish

epics.description: Reserved seating with temporary holds and no double booking.

issues.summary: Seat map data model (sections, rows, seats, price tiers)
acceptance: Prisma models and migration for sections, seats and price tiers
Seed script generates a seat map for the demo venue

issues.summary: Interactive seat map
issues.description: As a fan, I want to pick seats on a map so that I know exactly where I will sit.
acceptance: Available, held and sold seats are visually distinct
Maximum 6 seats per order
Keyboard accessible

issues.summary: Hold selected seats for 10 minutes
issues.description: As a fan, I want my chosen seats held while I check out so that nobody takes them.
acceptance: Hold lasts 10 minutes with a visible countdown
Held seats cannot be selected by others

issues.summary: Prevent double booking under concurrent requests
issues.description: As a fan, I want a guarantee that a seat I hold or buy is mine alone.
acceptance: Two simultaneous holds on the same seat: exactly one succeeds
Enforced in the database (transaction/constraint), not just the UI
Integration test fires concurrent requests to prove it

issues.summary: Release expired holds with BullMQ delayed jobs
acceptance: Delayed job scheduled when a hold is created
Expired, unpaid holds are released and broadcast to viewers
Job is idempotent (safe if a hold was already paid)

issues.summary: Join the waiting room for a high-demand on-sale
issues.description: As a fan, I want to join a fair queue when tickets go on sale so that bots and refreshers don't win.
acceptance: Users are queued first-come-first-served
Refreshing the page keeps your place

issues.summary: Admit queued users in batches via BullMQ worker
acceptance: Worker admits N users every interval (configurable)
Admitted users get a time-limited access token for checkout

issues.summary: Live queue position over WebSocket
issues.description: As a queued fan, I want to see my position update live so that I know how long to wait.
acceptance: Position and estimated wait update without refreshing
Fan is redirected automatically when admitted

issues.summary: Socket.IO server with Redis adapter and event rooms
acceptance: Socket.IO runs on the custom Next.js server
Worker can broadcast through the Redis emitter
Clients can only join valid event rooms

issues.summary: Live seat availability broadcast
issues.description: As a fan viewing a seat map, I want seats to update as others hold or buy them.
acceptance: Updates reach viewers of the same event within 1 second
Viewers of other events receive nothing

issues.summary: Check out and create an order (mock payment)
issues.description: As a fan with held seats, I want to pay so that the tickets become mine.
acceptance: Order total matches the seats' price tiers
Payment is simulated; success converts holds to sold seats atomically
Expired hold cannot be checked out

issues.summary: My tickets page
issues.description: As a fan, I want to see my upcoming tickets in one place.
acceptance: Lists orders with event, seats and date
Only the owner can view

issues.summary: Ticket with scannable QR code
issues.description: As a fan, I want a QR code per ticket so that I can enter the venue.
acceptance: Each ticket has a unique, unguessable code

issues.summary: Send order confirmation email via queue
acceptance: Email job enqueued on successful checkout and retried on failure

epics.description: Test planning, test design and project documentation.

issues.summary: Write test plan
acceptance: Scope, approach, environments, entry/exit criteria and risks documented

issues.summary: Test case specification using equivalence partitioning and boundary values
acceptance: Test cases for registration, holds, queue and checkout
Each case traces to a user story

issues.summary: Load test the waiting room with k6
acceptance: Report shows throughput and p95 latency at 500 virtual users

issues.summary: Final report and demo preparation
acceptance: Report covers PM, QA, pipeline, deployment and research
Demo script rehearsed end to end
